## Solarum 0.9.0 – a new name, a start screen and Solari 🌞

Bunker is now **Solarum**: techno from another planet – easy to use, beautiful to look at, for everyone.

> Solarum is still very much under development. Try it, break it, tell us what you think – criticism, ideas and help are very welcome: [open an issue](https://github.com/tj537/solarum/issues).

### A start screen, like a real app
- Solarum opens on a start screen: **New project**, **Open…**, **Back to** your last project, and **Let Solari play**.
- Your **recent projects** show as cards with a little picture of each groove – as many as your window has room for.
- The big green sun is the same one as in the planets view. Click it.

### Projects
- A project is one `.solarum` file: the groove and its twelve favorites with their names. A new project starts truly fresh – no favorites, no leftover settings.
- The top bar shows the project's name, with a dot when it has unsaved changes. **⌘/Ctrl + S** saves, *Save as…* asks where, and leaving a changed project asks first.

### Solari and SOLAR OS
- The auto mode is a little computer, **SOLAR OS**, with **Solari** the robot inside. Switch it on and Solari says hi and takes over – it keeps the beat you built and adds what's missing, one track per bar.
- Pick a vibe for Solari first – Hypnotic, Acid, Peak time, Dub, Melodic, Hard – or let it surprise you.
- Type to Solari: `shuffle`, `vibe acid`, `drop`, `mood dark`, `bpm 135`, `status`, `joke`, `help`.

### Sound and controls
- New sound section: a **character pad** (dark × acid), **SPACE**, **PUMP**, **KEY** and **DRIVE** as little pictures of what they do, and the **master EQ** as a curve with three points to drag.
- The filter is an **XY pad** with resonance. Effects are bigger and show what they do in moving pictures.
- **Energy** no longer has a drop zone – it simply mutes what it takes out (you see it on the mute buttons), and the sun glows in its colour: icy blue in a break, lime when full.
- **Tempo, metronome and mood** live together in the tempo box at the top. Solarum starts in *Neutral*; the auto mode picks moods by itself.
- **Recording** waits for play when you arm it while stopped, and leaves pauses out.
- **Clear** (the broom) resets the sound to its start; your favorites stay.

### Fixes
- Tracks no longer stay muted after the energy went down and back up.
- No sound from an empty pattern any more.

### Downloads

- **macOS 11+** (Apple Silicon & Intel): `Bunker-macos-universal.zip` (contains Solarum.app)
- **Windows 10/11:** `Bunker-windows-x64.zip` (contains Solarum.exe)

The Mac app is not notarized yet: on first launch, right-click → *Open*, or *System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway*. Windows SmartScreen may ask once: *More info → Run anyway*.
